# Filter the 'Total' row and get the yearly totals (excluding the final 'Total' column)
total_row = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Total'].iloc[0]
yearly_totals = total_row[['1939/40', '1940/41', '1941/42', '1942/43', '1943/44', '1944/45']]

# Get the reference values
ref_1939_40 = yearly_totals['1939/40']
ref_1940_41 = yearly_totals['1940/41']

# Find years where total deaths are > 1940/41 and < 1939/40
result_years = [
    year for year, value in yearly_totals.items()
    if ref_1940_41 < value < ref_1939_40
]
